contribution.position: My position on the reliability axis stands: artifact:perf-report records peak_memory at 740MB against a 512MB budget — a 44% overage at peak load — and that resource pressure maps directly onto the retry-storm failure mode behind last quarter's two sev2 incidents (artifact:incident-log). The green test suite and 87% coverage (artifact:test-report) establish functional correctness but say nothing about memory headroom under load, so the reliability evidence still points against shipping this week until the overage is explained or fixed.
